standard_prerequisites.name: The alternating Cech complex is the subcomplex of the usual Cech complex given by alternating cochains, whose p-cochains are alternating functions on (p+1)-tuples of indices with values in the sections over the corresponding intersection
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the target complex in which the image of Psi is described.

standard_prerequisites.name: The transition maps of the inverse system of Koszul complexes send the basis wedge [i_0,...,i_p] to the product of the functions times itself, matching the denominators of the formula
standard_prerequisites.use: Ensures Psi is compatible with the colimit system.

standard_prerequisites.name: Localized modules are described as colimits over powers of the inverting elements
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows Psi is an isomorphism of cochain modules in each degree in the colimit.

standard_prerequisites.name: The differentials on the Koszul complex used in the system are the negatives of the standard ones
standard_prerequisites.use: Accounts for the sign in the differential compatibility computation.

core_obligations: Describe both sides: an alternating p-cochain is a function s on {1,...,r}^{p+1} with values in M_{f_{i_0}...f_{i_p}}, while a p-cochain in Hom^bullet(I^bullet(f^e), M) is a map wedge^{p+1}(A^{⊕ r}) to M; define Psi(t)_{i_0...i_p} = (-1)^p t([i_0,...,i_p]) / (f_{i_0}...f_{i_p})^e; it is clear Psi(t) is an alternating cochain (proof lines 2142-2157).

Check compatibility with the transition maps: the transition map of the system (equation-system) sends [i_0,...,i_p] to f_{i_0}...f_{i_p} [i_0,...,i_p], which cancels the extra powers in the denominator, so Psi commutes with the colimit transitions (proof lines 2158-2166).

Degree-wise isomorphism: by the description of the localizations M_{f_{i_0}...f_{i_p}} as colimits (Algebra, Lemma localization-colimit), Psi defines an isomorphism of cochain modules in degree p in the colimit (proof lines 2167-2171).

Differential compatibility: compute d(Psi(t)) as the alternating sum over face deletions; using that the differentials on I^bullet(f^e) are the negatives of the Koszul differentials, compute Psi(d(t)) and verify the two formulas agree term by term, concluding the proof (proof lines 2171-2212).
proof_roadmap: Define Psi explicitly and note it lands in alternating cochains (proof lines 2142-2157).
Check compatibility with the system transitions (proof lines 2158-2166).
Get degree-wise isomorphism from the localization description (proof lines 2167-2171).
Verify differential compatibility by the two-formula sign computation (proof lines 2171-2212).
